name: blog-next-app
description: Demo blog application created with NextJS

paragraphs: This application serves as a technical showcase and a development playground. While my primary commercial work is protected by strict NDAs, this project is an open-source demonstration of my architectural approach, coding standards, and mastery of the modern Next.js ecosystem.

It is designed as a continuous learning sandbox where I implement and refine advanced full-stack patterns — from rigorous server-side security to complex state management — ensuring every feature adheres to industry best practices before being applied in production environments.
🎨 Tailwind v4 Version Available This branch uses SCSS Modules. A Tailwind CSS v4 version of this project is available in the tailwind branch.
features: Developed a specialized notification engine using React Context and useReducer.
Anti-Spam Logic: Integrated isPending state blocking to prevent duplicate notifications during rapid interactions.
Smart Auto-dismiss: Alerts persist for 6 seconds with manual close support.
Flash Messages: Reliable notification delivery across page redirects via Server Actions and client-side state synchronization.
Zero-Flash Injection: Implemented a blocking inline script in the to prevent the "white flash" (FOUC) during initial page loads.
